text:
sam: New hire hit a weird one: downloaded the zip, ran the EXE from Downloads, completed the browser auth but `redwoodctl whoami` returned unauthenticated.
nirav: classic temp-extract symptom. What does `redwoodctl profiles list --json` show?
sam: shows `default` -> C:\Users\user\.redwood and `default_tmp` -> C:\Users\user\AppData\Local\Temp\rwd-xyz. Token is in the temp one.
liz: Oof. So the callback wrote the token to the profile directory that matched the running binary. If they ran from Downloads, that's transient.
maya: Repro steps I used: unzip to Downloads, double-click exe, run `redwoodctl login`, finish browser flow, reopen terminal, `whoami` fails.
carla: Proposed fix: detect bin path on startup. If it's under %TEMP% or Downloads and there's an existing persistent profile, warn with actionable text: "Move the binary or run installer. To recover: run `redwoodctl migrate --from <tmp> --to default`".
nirav: Agreed. Also emit telemetry event `install.fallback_profile=true` (no PII) so PM can see how many users hit this.
sam: Could we auto-suggest the migrate command inline when the login callback runs and finds a temp profile? Less friction for non-technical folks.
liz: I'd prefer explicit prompt before moving credentials. UX should show exact paths and ask for confirmation. For headless CI we default to persistent.
carla: Add docs note in Quickstart: "If you used the zip, move the binary to a permanent folder before running `login`. If you already logged in, run `redwoodctl profiles list` and migrate tokens as needed."
support-bot: Support ticket created: #DX-8992. Include example `profiles list` output and recommended migrate steps.
maya: Tests: add Windows VM scenario where build unzips to Downloads and runs login; assert migration CLI moves tokens and `whoami` passes after migrate.
nirav: I'll ship a startup banner + telemetry this sprint, and iterate the migrate command next week. Leaving a TODO to ensure atomic copy+remove during migrate so creds aren't left behind.
sam: Good win for onboarding. This one confused at least two new hires yesterday.
carla: Closing loop once migration CLI + docs live.
